claim: In start.ts, loadEnvAndInitService calls SVC_ENV.setEnvironments and VaultSecurity.overWriteVaultEnv once before initService, and initService catches DB connection errors without retrying later.
flow: start.ts constructor -> loadEnvAndInitService -> initService -> new MainProcess

claim: In svc-env.ts, setEnvironments copies process.env into envServices and calls SVC_ENV.set for each key.
In domain/handlers/trans-his/GetAllTransHisExportPgHandler.ts, execute assigns const Model = this.mainProcess.models.TransHisPgModel and calls Model.getPage and Model.countDocuments.
In data-transfers/main-process.ts, initializeModels iterates over Object.keys(this.connections) and instantiates each ModelClass from ModelRegistry[alias] into this.models[modelName].
In logics/processors/BaseExportProcessor.ts, execute calls this.getConfig() and then this.validatePrerequisites(mainProcess, config) inside a try/catch block.
In dbHandler/DbConnectorFactory.ts, connect deletes key from this.pendingConnections in the finally block and stores connection in this.connections after connectPostgres succeeds.
In logics/health-check.logic.ts, checkDetailed iterates over DB_LIST and calls this.mainProcess.isDbConnected(alias) to report CONNECTED or DISCONNECTED for each alias.
In security/vault.security.ts, overWriteVaultEnv calls this.getVaultEnvs() and sets each key from vaultData onto SVC_ENV.
In utils/trans-his-export-source.ts, getTransHisExportSource defaults to 'mariadb' when TRANS_HIS_EXPORT_SOURCE is not set.
In defined/app-setting.ts, the 'trans-his-pg' entry in DB_LIST uses type 'mongodb' and uriEnvKey 'TRANS_HIS_PG_URI'.
